correctness.rationale: Taking first differences of the floor-square transform gives s*(2 id−u)=2 id−2u+δ. Since id=u*φ and u^{-1}=μ, inversion yields s=δ+(μ−δ)*H with H=(2φ−δ)^{-1}. Twisting H by the completely multiplicative λ produces ∏(1+px_p)/(1−K), where K=Σ_{∅≠S}(∏_{p∈S}p−2)∏x_p; all coefficients nonnegative and the singleton {2} is exactly zero. For n=2^a m, m odd, the twisted coefficient h(n)>0 iff a≤Ω(m)+1: necessity counts 2's against odd prime occurrences, and sufficiency takes one numerator x2 and a−1 positive x2 x_p factors. The squarefree-divisor convolution λ(n)s(n)=Σ_{d|n,d>1, μ(d)≠0}h(n/d) gives exact sign and zero threshold a≥Ω(m)+3. Modulo 2, H≡δ so s≡μ. Prime n gives −1; squarefree composite has at least two positive contributions and nonsquarefree n has even s, ruling out additional |s|=1. Boundaries n=1, powers of two, odd n, and repeated prime factors were explicitly checked. Independently regenerated the original recurrence through 1000 and tested every sign, zero, parity and prime case; no extrapolation relied on.
